usage_requirements: Cross-encoder NLI classifier (AutoModelForSequenceClassification), not an embedding model — takes (premise, hypothesis) pairs; no pooling or query/passage prefixes involved
Label order from config.json: 0=entailment, 1=neutral, 2=contradiction — differs from some other NLI models (e.g. bart-large-mnli), do not assume a shared mapping
Requires transformers >= 4.13 for the DeBERTa-v3 fast tokenizer; older versions produce tokenizer errors (per model card)
Checkpoint weights are stored in float16 (config torch_dtype: float16)
No trust_remote_code needed (standard deberta-v2 architecture in transformers)
Usable via the zero-shot-classification pipeline (pipeline tag on HF)
known_issues: HF community discussions flag a possible license inconsistency: model declared MIT while some training datasets (e.g. ANLI components) carry CC BY-NC 4.0 terms — review if commercial use is critical
Model card notes to consult the original DeBERTa paper for potential biases from the training data
config.json max_position_embeddings is 512; longer premise+hypothesis pairs are truncated
unknowns: embedding_dim (not applicable: cross-encoder NLI classifier, produces class logits not embeddings)
